title: Evaluation of a two-input gate
statement: Let $k$ be a gate kind other than negation, let $a$ and $b$ be natural-number input indices, and let $v$ be a list of Boolean values. The gate of kind $k$ with inputs $a,b$ evaluates to the binary operation associated with $k$ applied to the values at those indices, taking an out-of-range index to have value false.
hypotheses_covered: The gate kind is not negation
